entities.summary: Marianne Pitzen, GER, is a German artist born in Stuttgart. In 1981, Pitzen founded the Bonn Women's Museum, of which she is the current director. The museum hosts temporary exhibitions, and has hosted over 500 since its founding. Pitzen held her first exhibition in 1969, established a gallery in 1971, and later the "Circular" magazine with her husband. Marianne Pitzen was a authors & novelists from Stuttgart (b. 1948-05-29, Stuttgart). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
